title: Weekly Warm-Up
description: Catch-up warm-up para arrancar la clase: fin de semana, semana en curso, ánimo, novedades, y lo que viene. Filtro por nivel CEFR (A1 → C1).
topic: Weekly catch-up warm-up (past simple + present perfect + present tenses)

questions.question: How was your weekend? Tell me one thing you did.
What was the best part of your weekend?
Did you do anything different this weekend compared to a normal one?
Who did you spend time with over the weekend?
Did you cook or eat anything special this weekend?
Did you rest or was it a busy weekend?
What did you watch, listen to, or read this weekend?
If you could redo one thing from this weekend, what would it be and why?
Did you go anywhere on Saturday or Sunday? Tell me about it.
How has your week been so far?
What have you been working on this week?
Has anything unexpected happened this week?
Which day of the week has been the most intense so far, and why?
Have you been busy or has it been a quiet week?
What is one thing you have been trying to improve this week?
Have you seen your friends or family this week? Tell me about it.
Is there anything from last week that is still on your mind?
How are you feeling today, honestly?
Is your energy high or low today? What do you think is behind it?
What kind of mood have you been in lately?
If your week were a colour, what colour would it be, and why?
Has anything cheered you up recently?
Is there anything worrying you this week?
On a scale of 1 to 10, how good is your week going? Why that number?
What has helped you feel more balanced this week?
Any news since our last class? Tell me the first thing that comes to mind.
Has anything changed at work, school, or home recently?
Have you met anyone new or reconnected with someone lately?
What is one small thing you have discovered this week — a place, a song, a recipe?
Is there a piece of news — personal, local, or global — that you can't stop thinking about?
Has anyone in your family or circle had news lately?
Have you started or finished anything this week — a book, a series, a project?
What is one small win you have had this week?
What was the hardest moment of your week?
Have you managed to finish something you had been postponing?
Is there something you tried to do this week but couldn't? What got in the way?
What are you proud of yourself for, this week?
Have you learned something new this week — a fact, a skill, a lesson?
If a friend asked 'how is your week going, really?' — what would you tell them?
What are your plans for the rest of the week?
Are you looking forward to anything this week or weekend?
Is there something you have to finish before Friday?
What are you going to do this weekend? Any concrete plans?
If the rest of your week goes exactly as you want, what will you have done by Sunday night?
Is there anyone you are planning to see soon?
Is there something you are avoiding but should do this week?
What is one small thing you can do this week to make it feel more meaningful?
If today were a soundtrack, what song would be playing right now?
What has made you laugh recently?
If you had one extra hour today, how would you spend it?
What is one tiny thing that made you smile this week — something almost too small to mention?
Coffee, tea, or something else? What is fuelling your week?
Was your weekend good or bad?
Who was with you at the weekend?
Did you eat at home or at a restaurant?
What day is today?
Are you tired today? Yes or no?
Are you happy or sad today? Why?
What is your favourite drink in the morning?
What time do you finish work or school today?
Do you have plans for tonight?
What are you going to eat for dinner?
Do you have any news? Yes or no?
What's the weather like today?
Looking back on the past week, what pattern in your own behaviour would you most like to interrupt?
If you had to characterise the emotional tone of your week in a single phrase, what would it be — and what does that phrase reveal about you right now?
Is there a piece of recent news you feel you should care more about than you actually do? Why the gap?
What assumption did you make at the start of the week that turned out to be wrong?
Which of the things on your list for next week would you quietly like to drop, if you could get away with it?
How would a stranger who watched you all weekend describe your priorities?
What is a small, oddly specific detail of your week that you are unreasonably proud of noticing?
Where in your week this past few days did the gap between effort and outcome bother you the most?
Has a conversation you had this week made you reconsider a view you had held for a while?
When people asked how you were this week, what did you say — and how honest was that answer, really?
